groups.label: Main blooms
groups.blurb: Dusty-rose and ivory flowers building the soft upper mass of the hanging wall.

items.role: Dusty warm-pink Austin roses — the rounded main flower of this look.
Creamy ivory Austin roses woven through the pink mass.
Light pink ranunculus with layered petals softening the flower surface.
White phalaenopsis clusters lifting the lighter notes through the wall.
Light pink hydrangea balls filling out the upper blooms.
Ivory hydrangea balls brightening the lower mass.
Pale caramel hydrangea giving the vintage dried-flower tone in the picture.

groups.label: Cascading line flowers
groups.blurb: Long cream and pale-pink spikes carrying the waterfall movement downward.

items.role: Creamy white larkspur spikes — the most visible long cascade in this look.
Pale pink larkspur lifting finer vertical lines through the flowers.

groups.label: Fine fillers & texture
groups.blurb: Hazy whites and pale reed lines loosening the arrangement.

items.role: Fine white statice as a misty, airy filler through the whole wall.
Pale yellow reed lines adding the light fluffy dry-grass texture.

groups.label: Fine grass & vines
groups.blurb: Thin trailing lines, with no broad green leaves in this palette.

items.role: Fine misty trailing air grass hanging down without broad leaves.
Slender mountain-return vine stretching the trailing movement down the wall.
